#01_protein.concentration.empiria.Rmd

#Purpose:
#    Estimate protein concentration from SDS-PAGE BSA standard curve.

#Input:
#    Excel workbook containing integrated band intensity data and standard curve information.
#    The workbook must be generated in Empiria Studio 3.3 or equivalent.  

#Output:
#    1. Excel workbook containing the calculation steps and final concentration estimate for each band.
#	   2. Standard curve plot and estimated values.

## R Markdown

```{r}
# Load necessary packages
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(openxlsx)
```

```{r}
# Read the Excel file
file_path <- file.choose()
df <- read_excel(file_path, sheet = if ("700" %in% excel_sheets(file_path)) "700" else "800", skip = 8)
# Assign a value to source_sheet_name
source_sheet_name <- if ("700" %in% excel_sheets(file_path)) "700" else "800"
```

```{r}
# Convert data to numeric and calculate BSA mass
df$`Amount (µl)` <- as.numeric(df$`Amount (µl)`)
df$Signal <- as.numeric(df$Signal)
df$`Relative Amount` <- ifelse(df$Type == "Positive" & grepl("^B", df$`Band Name`), df$`Amount (µl)` * 0.25, NA)
```

```{r}
# Create a linear model based on BSA values
bsa_rows <- df$Type == "Positive" & grepl("^B", df$`Band Name`)
bsa_model <- lm(`Relative Amount` ~ Signal, data = df[bsa_rows, ])
```

```{r}
# Fit the sample information to extrapolate the mass
sample_rows <- df$Type == "Sample" & df$`Band Name` != "Total Lane Signal"
df$`Relative Amount`[sample_rows] <- predict(bsa_model, newdata = df[sample_rows, ])
```

```{r}
# Fit the sample information to extrapolate the mass
sample_rows <- df$Type == "Sample" & df$`Band Name` != "Total Lane Signal"
df$`Relative Amount`[sample_rows] <- predict(bsa_model, newdata = df[sample_rows, ])
```

```{r}
# Fit the sample information to extrapolate the mass
sample_rows <- df$Type == "Sample" & df$`Band Name` != "Total Lane Signal"
df$`Relative Amount`[sample_rows] <- predict(bsa_model, newdata = df[sample_rows, ])
```

```{r}
# Create a new factor that combines Name and Band Name
df$SampleVariation <- interaction(df$Name, df$`Band Name`)

# Reorder the levels of SampleVariation alphabetically
df$SampleVariation <- factor(df$SampleVariation, levels = sort(levels(df$SampleVariation)))

# Get unique sample variations that actually appear in the sample data
unique_sample_variations <- unique(df$SampleVariation[sample_rows])

# Define a color palette for the sample variations - generate enough colors for all unique samples
sample_colors <- scales::hue_pal()(length(unique_sample_variations))

# Create a named vector for the colors - only map colors for samples that exist
sample_color_mapping <- setNames(sample_colors, unique_sample_variations)
color_mapping <- c("Positive" = "#333334", sample_color_mapping)

# Plot the final model with separate colors for each sample variation
model.plot <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Signal, y = `Relative Amount`)) +
  geom_point(data = df[bsa_rows, ], aes(color = "Positive"), size = 4) +
  geom_point(data = df[sample_rows, ], aes(color = SampleVariation), size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(data = df[bsa_rows, ], method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black") +
  labs(title = "Linear Model of BSA and Sample Mass",
       x = "Integrated Intensity (AU)",
       y = "Relative Amount (μg)") +
  scale_color_manual(values = color_mapping) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA))


# Display the plot
model.plot

# Save the plot to a file
ggsave("model.plot.png", model.plot)
```

```{r}
# Load the existing workbook or create a new one
if (file.exists(file_path)) {
  wb <- loadWorkbook(file_path)
} else {
  wb <- createWorkbook()
}

# Generate the sheet name with today's date and sequential number
today <- format(Sys.Date(), "%y.%m.%d")
sheet_base <- paste0(today, "_")
i <- 1
sheet_name <- paste0(sheet_base, sprintf("%02d", i))
while (sheet_name %in% names(wb)) {
  i <- i + 1
  sheet_name <- paste0(sheet_base, sprintf("%02d", i))
}

# Create a new sheet with "_res" added to the name
res_sheet_name <- paste0(sheet_name)
addWorksheet(wb, res_sheet_name)

# Write the results to the new sheet
writeData(wb, res_sheet_name, "Protein concentration report", startCol = 1, startRow = 1)
writeData(wb, res_sheet_name, "Assumptions:", startCol = 1, startRow = 2)
writeData(wb, res_sheet_name, "BSA conc. 0.25 mg/mL", startCol = 1, startRow = 3)
writeData(wb, res_sheet_name, "Sheet name 700 or 800", startCol = 1, startRow = 4)
writeData(wb, res_sheet_name, "R2:", startCol = 1, startRow = 6)
writeData(wb, res_sheet_name, summary(bsa_model)$adj.r.squared, startCol = 1, startRow = 7)

# Write the plot to the new sheet
insertImage(wb, res_sheet_name, "model.plot.png", startCol = 2, startRow = 2, width = 6, height = 4)

# Write the headings horizontally
write# Determine the starting row for the new data
last_row <- 22
start_row <- last_row + 2

# Create the new data frame with the specified headings, ignoring "Total Lane Signal" rows
result_df <- df %>%
  filter(Type == "Sample" & `Band Name` != "Total Lane Signal") %>%
  group_by(Name, `Band Name`) %>%
  mutate(Replicate = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(Replicate, Name, `Band Name`, Signal, `Amount (µl)`, Mass = `Relative Amount`) %>%
  mutate(Concentration = Mass / `Amount (µl)`)

# Display the resulting data frame
print(result_df)

# Define styles
header_style <- createStyle(textDecoration = "bold")
avg_row_style <- createStyle(fgFill = "#D3D3D3")  # Light grey background
border_style <- createStyle(border = "TopBottomLeftRight", borderStyle = "thin")
thick_border_style_top_bottom <- createStyle(border = c("top", "bottom"), borderStyle = "thick")
thick_border_style_top <- createStyle(border = "top", borderStyle = "thick")
thick_border_style_bottom <- createStyle(border = "bottom", borderStyle = "thick")
thick_border_style_left_right <- createStyle(border = c("left", "right"), borderStyle = "thick")
thick_border_style_left <- createStyle(border = "left", borderStyle = "thick")
thick_border_style_right <- createStyle(border = "right", borderStyle = "thick")
number_format_style <- createStyle(numFmt = "0.000")  # 3 digits after the decimal point

# Write the headings horizontally
writeData(wb, res_sheet_name, t(data.frame(c("Replicate", "Name", "Band Name", "Signal", "Amount (µl)", "Mass (µg)", "Concentration (mg/mL)"))), startCol = 2, startRow = start_row, colNames = FALSE)
addStyle(wb, res_sheet_name, header_style, rows = start_row, cols = 2:8, gridExpand = TRUE)

# Fill the table with data, keeping groups together
current_row <- start_row + 1
result_df %>%
  group_by(Name, `Band Name`) %>%
  do({
    data <- .
    writeData(wb, res_sheet_name, data, startCol = 2, startRow = current_row, colNames = FALSE)
    addStyle(wb, res_sheet_name, border_style, rows = current_row:(current_row + nrow(data) - 1), cols = 2:8, gridExpand = TRUE)
    addStyle(wb, res_sheet_name, number_format_style, rows = current_row:(current_row + nrow(data) - 1), cols = 5:8, gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE)  # Apply number format
    current_row <<- current_row + nrow(data)
    avg_row <- data.frame(Replicate = "Avg.", Name = unique(data$Name), `Band Name` = unique(data$`Band Name`),
                          Signal = mean(data$Signal), `Amount (µl)` = mean(data$`Amount (µl)`), Mass = mean(data$Mass), Concentration = mean(data$Concentration))
    writeData(wb, res_sheet_name, avg_row, startCol = 2, startRow = current_row, colNames = FALSE)
    
    addStyle(wb, res_sheet_name, border_style, rows = current_row, cols = 2:8, gridExpand = TRUE)
    addStyle(wb, res_sheet_name, avg_row_style, rows = current_row, cols = 2:8, gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE)
    addStyle(wb, res_sheet_name, number_format_style, rows = current_row, cols = 5:8, gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE)  # Apply number forma
    current_row <<- current_row + 1
    data
  })

# Apply thick borders around the edges of the table
addStyle(wb, res_sheet_name, border_style, rows = start_row, cols = 2:8, gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE)
addStyle(wb, res_sheet_name, thick_border_style_top, rows = start_row, cols = 2:8, gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE)
addStyle(wb, res_sheet_name, thick_border_style_bottom, rows = current_row - 1, cols = 2:8, gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE)
addStyle(wb, res_sheet_name, thick_border_style_left, rows = start_row:(current_row - 1), cols = 2, gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE)
addStyle(wb, res_sheet_name, thick_border_style_right, rows = start_row:(current_row - 1), cols = 8, gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE)

setColWidths(wb, sheet = res_sheet_name, cols = 1:1000, widths = "auto")

# Save the workbook
saveWorkbook(wb, file_path, overwrite = TRUE)
```
